page.content:
Yellow-headed posable figure that populated City, Castle, and licensed themes.

How Minifigure connects

  • Concept: System of Play — The minifigure is the standard character scale of the System of Play.
  • Faction: The LEGO Group — The LEGO Group introduced the minifigure in 1978.
  • Work: LEGO City — LEGO City populates its streets and vehicles with minifigures.
  • Work: LEGO Star Wars — LEGO Star Wars translates film characters into minifigures.
  • Work: LEGO Castle — LEGO Castle knights and forest factions are minifigure-scale.
  • Character: Kjeld Kirk Kristiansen — Kjeld's era is when the minifigure and classic themes scaled worldwide.

What is Minifigure?

The minifigure, introduced in 1978, is the standard LEGO person: C-shaped hands, peg legs, and a printed face that let Castle knights, City civilians, and Star Wars characters share the same scale.

Key threads lead to System of Play, The LEGO Group, LEGO City, LEGO Star Wars, LEGO Castle and Kjeld Kirk Kristiansen.
